# Fountain City Strategy

> Fountain City Strategy, LLC is a marketing, partnership, and go-to-market strategy consultancy based in Kansas City, Missouri, founded in 2026 by Matt Morgan. It works with growing brands, B2B firms, and nonprofits on a fractional and project basis.

## Services
- Marketing and brand audits
- Go-to-market and launch planning
- Partnership and channel programs
- Content and search strategy, including AI search visibility (generative engine optimization)
- Sales enablement
- Marketing measurement and reporting

## Engagement types
- Starter projects, fixed-fee projects, monthly retainers (three months or longer), hourly advisory, and fractional leadership
